Secure Website Transfers & Upgrades

Website Migration Services for Secure Transfers, WordPress Moves & Website Upgrades

Moving a website to a new host, changing a domain, upgrading WordPress, or switching website platforms can create serious problems when the process is not properly planned. Broken pages, missing files, database errors, failed redirects, SSL issues, and search visibility problems can all occur during an unsuccessful migration.

Our professional website migration services help businesses move, transfer, and upgrade their websites with a structured technical process.  As a Houston-based website migration company serving clients across the United States, we provide technical support for WordPress migrations, hosting transfers, domain changes, website upgrades, and other complex website moves.

Whether you need to migrate a website to a new host or upgrade an existing WordPress website, our team helps manage the technical details so your transition is organized and your website is prepared for launch.

Backup-First Process | Minimized Downtime | US-Based Support

Migration Planning

A structured plan before important files are moved

Backup Protection

Website files and databases backed up before major changes

SEO-Aware Transfer

URL structures and redirects reviewed during applicable migrations

Full Testing

Important pages and functionality checked after migration

Get a Free Migration Consultation

Since 2013

Website repair & SEO recovery experience

1,000+ Websites

Repaired across multiple industries

24/7 Support

Emergency help — call or text anytime

Since 2013

Houston-based, serving clients nationwide

What Are Website Migration Services?

Website migration is the process of moving or making significant changes to a website’s technical environment. This can involve transferring website files and databases to a new hosting provider, changing domains, moving to a new server, upgrading the website platform, or replacing important themes and software components.

A professional website transfer service should consider more than simply copying files from one location to another.

Depending on the type of migration, the process may involve:

  • Creating complete website and database backups
  • Reviewing the existing hosting environment
  • Preparing the new hosting or server environment
  • Transferring website files and databases
  • Updating configuration files and technical settings
  • Testing themes, plugins, and integrations
  • Updating DNS and domain settings
  • Reviewing SSL and HTTPS configuration
  • Managing URL changes and redirects where required
  • Checking important website functionality
  • Testing the website after launch

Every migration is different. Moving a small WordPress website to a new host is not the same as changing the domain of a large business website or completing a complex website platform migration.

Our role is to review the technical requirements of your move and create an appropriate migration process before changes are made.

How We Work

Our process is clear, efficient, and built around your needs

01

Free Consultation

We start by reviewing your site and identifying the problems — whether it’s SEO, loading speed, DNS errors, or broken features.

02

Live Diagnosis

We schedule a live session (via phone, Zoom, or Google Meet) to walk you through the issues and explain what needs fixing.

03

Secure Backup

Before making any changes, we take a complete backup of your site to ensure your data is protected.

04

Fast Repairs

Most issues are resolved within 1–3 business days. We fix, test, and verify every change for full functionality.

05

Ongoing Support

After the job is done, we offer guidance, reports, and optional ongoing support to keep your site running strong.

Website Migration Services We Handle

Businesses choose to move or upgrade their websites for many reasons. Your current hosting may no longer meet your performance requirements, your website platform may be outdated, your business may be changing its brand, or a major software upgrade may be necessary.

Our website migration services can support several types of website transfers and upgrades.

Website Hosting Migration

If your current hosting provider is causing performance, reliability, support, or technical limitations, we can help you move your website to a new hosting environment.

A website hosting migration may involve transferring:

  • Website files
  • Databases
  • Email-related website configurations when applicable
  • DNS settings
  • SSL configurations
  • Server-level settings
  • Website applications and integrations

Before moving the website, we review the existing and new environments to identify compatibility requirements.

If you need to migrate your website to a new host, we help manage the transfer and test the website after the migration is completed.

Website Server Migration

A website server migration may be necessary when moving between servers, upgrading infrastructure, changing hosting configurations, or improving the technical environment supporting your website.

Server migrations can require additional attention to:

  • PHP versions
  • Database versions
  • Server software
  • File permissions
  • Caching configurations
  • SSL settings
  • Website application requirements

Differences between the old and new environments can cause unexpected errors. We review these technical factors and address compatibility concerns as part of the migration process.

Domain Changes & Website Transfers

Changing a domain involves more than registering a new website address. Search engines, visitors, internal links, forms, images, and other website components may still rely on the old URLs.

Our website migration process can include reviewing:

  • Existing website URLs
  • Important page redirects
  • Internal links
  • Canonical settings
  • Sitemap updates
  • SSL configuration
  • Domain and DNS settings
  • Website functionality after the domain change

A properly planned domain migration helps reduce avoidable technical problems and provides a clearer transition from the old website address to the new one.

Website Platform Migration

A website platform migration involves moving from one content management system or website environment to another.

Depending on the project, this can involve:

  • Content transfer
  • Image and media migration
  • URL mapping
  • Redirect planning
  • Design and functionality review
  • Form and integration setup
  • SEO-related technical checks
  • Pre-launch and post-launch testing

Platform migrations require careful planning because not every feature, URL, or content structure transfers automatically.

Professional WordPress Migration Service for Hosting, Domains & Website Moves

WordPress websites often depend on a combination of core files, themes, plugins, databases, page builders, and third-party integrations. Moving all these components correctly requires more than exporting a few files.

Our WordPress migration service helps businesses move WordPress websites while reviewing the technical components that need to continue functioning after the transfer.

We can assist with WordPress website migration projects involving:

  • Moving WordPress to a new hosting provider
  • WordPress server transfers
  • Domain changes
  • Database migration
  • HTTP to HTTPS transitions
  • Website staging and production moves
  • Theme and page builder compatibility
  • Plugin compatibility checks
  • PHP and WordPress version changes
  • WooCommerce website migration
  • Website restoration after an unsuccessful move

What We Check During a WordPress Migration

Before and after the move, we review applicable areas of the website, including:

  • Website files and database connectivity
  • WordPress configuration settings
  • Theme and plugin functionality
  • Page layouts and important website pages
  • Contact forms and key integrations
  • Login and admin access
  • Images, links, and media files
  • SSL and HTTPS functionality
  • Mobile website display
  • Important redirects and URL behavior

The exact checks depend on your website and the type of migration being completed.

Our approach is based on planning, compatibility checks, backups, and testing rather than moving the website first and trying to resolve preventable problems afterward.

Website Upgrade Services for Outdated or Growing Websites

Sometimes a website does not need to move to a different host or domain. Instead, its technical environment needs to be upgraded.

Our website upgrade services help businesses address outdated software and website components that may affect security, compatibility, performance, or functionality.

We can assist with projects involving:

  • WordPress version upgrades
  • PHP version compatibility upgrades
  • Theme upgrades
  • Plugin updates and compatibility reviews
  • Page builder upgrades
  • Website framework or platform upgrades
  • Server environment changes
  • HTTPS and security-related upgrades
  • Database-related technical upgrades

Why Website Upgrades Require Planning

Major upgrades can sometimes affect older themes, plugins, custom code, and third-party integrations.

For example, a website running an outdated PHP version may contain plugins or custom functionality that no longer work correctly after an upgrade. Similarly, updating a page builder or theme can affect layouts that were created using older versions.

Before completing significant changes, we review the website’s technical environment and identify compatibility concerns that may require attention.

Where appropriate, we use a staged or controlled process to test important changes before they affect the live website.

Need to move, upgrade, or transfer your website? Start with a technical review before making major changes.

Get in touch

  • (+1) 832 266 7209
  • info@fixwebsiteissues.com
  • Houston, Texas — serving all 50 states
Free Consultation

Why WevTEC

  • No deposit — pay after it's fixed
  • Pay only after the work is done
  • Complete backup before any change
  • No long-term contracts
Getting Started

Quick and hassle-free from the first call

Getting your WordPress website repaired is quick and hassle-free. Simply call us at 832-266-7209, or submit your contact information — and we’ll get back to you promptly.

Once we connect, we’ll schedule a live website review with you, either by phone, Zoom, or Google Meet (whichever works best). During this session, we’ll:

  • Review your website in real-time

  • Identify and explain the issues you’re facing

  • Provide a clear solution and expected timeline

  • Begin work immediately — after taking a full backup of your current website

We prioritize secure and transparent repairs, ensuring your website data and functionality are fully protected throughout the process. As a trusted USA-based website repair service, we understand how important your site is to your business — and we treat every repair with the urgency and care it deserves.

Speak to a Website Expert Now
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Website Migration Services

Still have questions?

Call or text us anytime — real experts, 24/7.

(832) 266 7209
What are website migration services?

Website migration services involve moving a website from one technical environment to another. This may include changing hosting providers, moving to a new server, transferring a WordPress website, changing domains, moving from HTTP to HTTPS, or upgrading important website software.

The process can involve transferring website files and databases, updating configurations, checking compatibility, and testing the website after the move.

Can you migrate my WordPress website to a new host?

Yes. Our WordPress migration service can help move your WordPress files, database, themes, plugins, media, and necessary configurations to a new hosting environment.

We also test important website functionality after the migration and investigate any technical issues that appear during the process.

Will I lose my website data during migration?

We take backups before major migration work whenever the website environment allows. This creates a recovery point before changes are made.

While careful planning is essential for reducing risk, the exact migration process depends on your website’s current setup, hosting environment, and the changes being completed.

Will my website stay online during the migration?

Many migrations can be planned to minimize visitor disruption. The exact downtime risk depends on factors such as the hosting environment, website size, DNS changes, and the type of migration.

We plan the process carefully and test the new environment before completing the final transition whenever possible.

Can you fix a website migration that already failed?

Yes. If your website stopped working after moving to a new host or server, we can review the migration-related setup and identify technical problems.

We can help with database errors, broken pages, missing images, plugin conflicts, login problems, SSL issues, redirects, and other post-migration errors.

Seamless Website Migration and Upgrade Services Without the Technical Risk

Moving a website involves much more than copying files from one server to another. A successful migration requires careful planning, data protection, compatibility checks, testing, and proper configuration before the new website environment goes live.

Our website migration services are designed to handle the technical work while helping protect your website’s functionality, content, and search visibility. Whether you need to migrate a website to a new host, transfer a domain, upgrade WordPress, or move to a more reliable server environment, our team manages the process from start to finish.

We carefully review your existing website before making changes, create secure backups, prepare the destination environment, complete the transfer, and test critical functionality before finalizing the migration.

We Help With

  • Website hosting migration
  • WordPress website migration
  • Website server migration
  • Domain name transfers and changes
  • WordPress version upgrades
  • PHP upgrades and compatibility fixes
  • Theme upgrades
  • Plugin upgrades
  • HTTP to HTTPS migration
  • Website platform migration
  • Failed migration repair
  • Post-migration error fixing
  • Database transfer and configuration
  • DNS and domain configuration
  • URL redirect setup
  • Staging and pre-launch testing

Discuss Your Website Migration

Website Migration Services for Hosts, Domains, WordPress, and More

Every website move is different. Some businesses simply need a website hosting migration, while others are moving an entire WordPress website, changing domains, upgrading outdated software, or dealing with a migration that has already failed.

We adapt the migration process to your website’s current setup and the changes you need to make.

Website Hosting Migration

Need to move your website to a new hosting provider? We transfer your website files, databases, configurations, and other necessary components to the new environment.

Before making the switch, we review the new hosting setup to identify potential compatibility concerns. After the transfer, we test the website and important functions before completing the DNS transition.

Our goal is to make the move as smooth as possible while minimizing disruption to your business.

WordPress Website Migration

A WordPress migration service requires careful handling because a WordPress website depends on multiple connected components. These can include the WordPress core, database, themes, plugins, media files, server settings, PHP version, and caching configuration.

We review these elements before and after the move to help prevent common problems such as:

  • Blank or broken pages
  • Database connection errors
  • Missing images
  • Plugin conflicts
  • Theme display problems
  • Broken contact forms
  • Login and dashboard issues
  • Incorrect redirects
  • Mixed-content warnings
  • PHP compatibility errors

Domain Migration and Website Transfers

Changing your domain requires more than registering a new name. URLs, internal links, redirects, SSL certificates, search engine settings, and other technical elements may need attention.

Our website transfer service can help manage the technical side of a domain change while creating the necessary redirect structure from important old URLs to their new destinations.

This helps visitors continue finding the correct pages and provides a cleaner transition when your business is rebranding or changing domains.

WordPress and Website Upgrade Services

Older WordPress installations, themes, plugins, and PHP versions can eventually create security, compatibility, and performance problems. However, upgrading everything without preparation can also cause errors.

Our website upgrade services follow a more controlled process. We first assess the current environment and identify compatibility concerns before applying major updates.

We can help with:

  • WordPress core upgrades
  • PHP version upgrades
  • Theme updates
  • Plugin updates
  • Page builder compatibility
  • WooCommerce upgrades
  • Database updates
  • Server environment changes

Changing Hosts or Upgrading Your Website?

Move your website with a structured plan, complete backup, compatibility checks, and testing before launch.

Call 832 266 7209 for a Free Consultation

How Our Website Migration Process Works

A reliable migration should not be rushed. We follow a structured process to reduce unnecessary risks and make sure important website functions are reviewed throughout the transfer.

01. Website Review and Migration Planning

We begin by reviewing your current website, hosting environment, technical setup, and the reason for the migration or upgrade.

This helps us understand what needs to be transferred and identify possible issues before work begins.

02. Complete Website Backup

Before making changes, we create a backup of the website and its important data. This provides a recovery point during the migration process.

Depending on the website setup, this may include:

  • Website files
  • WordPress database
  • Media files
  • Configuration files
  • Important settings

03. New Environment Preparation

Before moving the website, we prepare and review the destination environment. This may include checking hosting resources, PHP compatibility, database setup, SSL requirements, and other technical configurations.

04. Website and Database Transfer

We transfer the necessary website files and database to the new server or environment. URLs and configuration settings are updated where required.

05. Compatibility and Functionality Checks

After the transfer, we test the website for issues involving pages, layouts, plugins, forms, images, login access, and other important functions.

If you are completing a major upgrade, we also review compatibility between the updated environment and your existing website components.

06. SEO and Redirect Review

When a migration involves changing URLs, domains, or site structure, we review the redirect setup and important SEO-related technical elements.

Our process may include checking:

  • Important URL redirects
  • Internal links
  • HTTPS configuration
  • Canonical settings
  • Indexing-related settings
  • Broken pages after migration

07. Final Testing and Launch

Before completing the migration, we perform final checks to confirm the website is functioning properly in its new environment.

We test key pages and features so problems can be identified before or immediately after the transition.

We Can Repair a Failed Website Migration

Not every website migration goes according to plan. A transfer completed without proper preparation can result in broken pages, missing files, database errors, redirect problems, or a website that no longer loads correctly.

If your website was moved and something went wrong, we can review the current setup to identify the source of the problem.

Common post-migration issues we help fix include:

  • Website not loading after migration
  • Error establishing a database connection
  • Internal server errors
  • White screen errors
  • Broken CSS or layouts
  • Missing images and media
  • WordPress login problems
  • Plugin or theme conflicts
  • Incorrect domain configuration
  • SSL and HTTPS errors
  • Broken redirects
  • 404 errors
  • Email or contact form issues
  • Slow website performance after moving servers

Instead of making random changes, we review the migration, server environment, configuration, and website components to identify what is causing the issue.

SEO-Safe Website Migration for a Smoother Transition

One of the biggest concerns during a website migration is the possible impact on organic search visibility. Changes to domains, URLs, website structure, server settings, or HTTPS can create technical problems if the transition is not properly managed.

Search visibility cannot be guaranteed because rankings depend on many factors, but technical mistakes during a migration can create avoidable problems.

Our migration process includes attention to important technical elements such as:

  • Proper redirect implementation when URLs change
  • HTTPS configuration
  • Internal link review
  • Important page accessibility
  • Broken-page checks
  • Sitemap and technical SEO review where applicable
  • Monitoring for obvious migration-related errors

The goal is to complete the technical transition cleanly and avoid unnecessary disruptions caused by incorrect migration setup.

Moving to a New Domain?

Changing your domain without a proper redirect and migration plan can create unnecessary problems. Let us review the move before your website goes live.

Talk to a Migration Specialist

Why Businesses Choose Our Website Migration Company

When you hire a website migration company, you need more than someone who can copy website files. You need technical support that understands how servers, databases, WordPress, plugins, domains, security, and website functionality work together.

At Fix Website Issues, we approach every migration as a technical project that requires planning and verification.

Root-Cause Technical Experience

Our team regularly works with websites experiencing errors, broken functionality, compatibility problems, and server-related issues. This experience helps us identify potential concerns during migrations and upgrades.

Backup Before Major Changes

We believe important website changes should begin with a reliable recovery plan. Backups are created before significant migration or upgrade work begins whenever the website environment allows.

Testing Before Final Handover

We do not consider a migration complete simply because the files have been transferred. Important website functions should be reviewed after the move.

Support Beyond the Transfer

If migration-related issues appear, we can investigate the problem and provide technical support to restore proper functionality.

Nationwide Service From a U.S.-Based Team

Our team supports businesses across the United States remotely. Whether your company is located in Texas, Florida, California, New York, Illinois, Georgia, or elsewhere in the country, we can review your website migration requirements and provide remote technical support.

Start Your Website Migration With a Clear Plan

Before moving your website, changing hosts, transferring a domain, or applying major upgrades, it helps to understand exactly what the process involves.

We can review your current website and discuss:

  • What type of migration you need
  • The technical requirements involved
  • Potential compatibility concerns
  • Backup and recovery planning
  • Expected migration steps
  • Important functionality that needs testing

You do not have to move a single file before speaking with a specialist.

Call for a Free Website Migration Consultation

Tell us what you are moving and where you want to move it. We will help you understand the next steps and discuss the technical work required.

832 266 7209 — Call Now

Or request an online consultation and our team will get back to you promptly.

Website Migration Services for Businesses Across the United States

Website migrations are not limited by location. Our team provides remote website migration services for businesses across the United States, helping companies move websites, change hosting providers, upgrade WordPress, transfer domains, and resolve migration-related problems.

Whether your business is based in Texas, Florida, California, New York, Georgia, Illinois, or another state, we can review your website setup and handle the technical work remotely.

Our nationwide support includes:

  • Website hosting migration
  • WordPress website migration
  • Website server migration
  • Domain transfers and domain changes
  • Website upgrade services
  • WordPress core and PHP upgrades
  • Theme and plugin compatibility updates
  • HTTP to HTTPS migration
  • Website platform migration
  • Failed migration repair
  • Post-migration troubleshooting
  • SEO-related migration checks

You do not need a local developer sitting in your office to move a website safely. What matters is having an experienced team that can assess the existing setup, plan the transfer correctly, create backups, test the new environment, and troubleshoot issues when necessary.

Moving Your Website to a New Host?

Let us review your website before the migration starts and help prevent unnecessary errors.

WordPress Website Upgrade Services for Outdated and Unstable Websites

An outdated website can eventually create compatibility, performance, and security concerns. However, updating WordPress, PHP, themes, and plugins without checking compatibility can cause a completely different problem: a website that breaks immediately after the upgrade.

That is why our website upgrade services focus on planning and testing before major changes are finalized.

We can review your existing WordPress installation and help with upgrades involving:

WordPress Core

Older WordPress versions may eventually need to be updated for compatibility, functionality, or security reasons. Before upgrading, we review the website’s existing setup to identify components that may require additional attention.

PHP Version

A hosting provider may require you to upgrade your PHP version. Older themes and plugins can sometimes become incompatible with newer PHP environments, resulting in warnings, errors, or broken functionality.

We review the website and address compatibility issues where needed.

Themes and Page Builders

Major updates involving themes or page builders can affect layouts and frontend functionality. Websites built with Elementor, WPBakery, Divi, Avada, Astra, or other platforms may require additional compatibility checks.

We help identify and resolve issues such as:

  • Broken page layouts
  • Missing sections or styling
  • Mobile display problems
  • Builder editor errors
  • Theme conflicts
  • CSS or JavaScript issues

Plugins and Integrations

Plugins often interact with WordPress, themes, payment systems, forms, analytics tools, and third-party services. Updating one component without reviewing the others can sometimes create conflicts.

Our process helps identify whether updates are affecting website functionality and addresses issues that need technical repair.

What Makes a Successful Website Migration?

A website may appear to have moved successfully while important technical issues remain hidden. For example, pages may load while forms stop working, images may be missing, redirects may be incorrect, or certain plugins may fail in the new server environment.

A proper migration should consider the complete website environment.

Data

Website files, databases, media, content, and important configurations need to be transferred correctly.

Functionality

Important features such as contact forms, logins, checkout systems, navigation, search tools, and third-party integrations should be checked after the move.

Compatibility

The new server environment should work properly with your WordPress version, PHP version, themes, plugins, and other website components.

Security

SSL, HTTPS configuration, file permissions, and other security-related settings may need to be reviewed after the migration.

Search Visibility

When domains or URLs change, redirects and important technical SEO settings need attention to reduce avoidable migration-related problems.

Performance

A new hosting environment can affect loading speed and server response. Post-migration checks can identify obvious performance concerns.

Our goal is not simply to move your website. We aim to complete the technical transition with a structured process that helps your website continue operating properly after the migration.

What We Check Before and After Moving Your Website

Every website is different, but our WordPress migration service may involve reviewing the following areas based on your migration requirements.

Before Migration

  • Current website accessibility
  • Website files and database
  • Hosting environment
  • WordPress version
  • PHP version
  • Active theme and plugins
  • Website storage and resource requirements
  • SSL and HTTPS setup
  • Domain and DNS configuration
  • Important website functionality
  • Existing backups

During Migration

  • File transfer
  • Database migration
  • Configuration updates
  • URL adjustments where required
  • Server environment setup
  • Domain configuration
  • SSL installation or configuration
  • Staging or temporary testing

After Migration

  • Website accessibility
  • Important pages
  • Layout and styling
  • Images and media
  • Contact forms
  • Login and dashboard access
  • Plugin functionality
  • Theme functionality
  • Mobile responsiveness
  • HTTPS status
  • Redirects where applicable
  • Obvious migration-related errors

This structured approach helps reduce the risk of overlooking important parts of the website.

Fix Website Migration Errors Before They Create Bigger Problems

If you have already attempted to migrate your website and something is no longer working, do not continue making random changes to the files or server settings.

A failed migration can involve multiple connected issues. For example, an incorrect database configuration may prevent the website from loading, while a PHP compatibility issue may create additional errors after the site becomes accessible.

Our team can investigate problems involving:

  • WordPress not loading after migration
  • Error establishing a database connection
  • Internal server errors
  • White screen errors
